admin.lead: Admin-only features such as user management and rate limits will appear here when your account has admin access and the backend supports them.

admin.updateError429: Too many requests. Use the bypass key in .env or wait before saving again.
admin.validationPositive: Window and max requests must be positive numbers.
admin.disableAllHint: Turns off every enabled rule so the API stops enforcing those limits. Re-enable individual rules when you are ready.
admin.disableAllError429: Rate limited while disabling rules. Configure the admin bypass key or wait.
admin.rateLimitHitBody: The admin API returned HTTP 429. That can include this list request.
admin.rateLimitBypassHint: If the backend has RATE_LIMIT_ADMIN_BYPASS=true, set VITE_RATE_LIMIT_ADMIN_BYPASS_KEY in your frontend .env to the same value as RATE_LIMIT_ADMIN_BYPASS_KEY, restart the dev server, then retry.
admin.usersLead: Assign global roles (USER, SUPPORT, ADMIN). You cannot remove your own admin role here—the API will reject self-demotion.

admin.title: Administration
admin.summarySubtitle: Quick counts for users and rate limits.
admin.roadmapSecuritySubtitle: In progress — temporary passwords in the user directory.
admin.roadmapComplianceSubtitle: API ready — admin audit log; in-app review still planned.
admin.roadmapSecurityItem1: Live: issue a one-time password from the user directory (manual relay). That user’s sessions are signed out everywhere.
admin.roadmapSecurityItem2: Planned: email-based reset and expiring tokens.
admin.roadmapSecurityItem3: Planned: dedicated “revoke all sessions”, soft-disable or suspend accounts without deleting history.
admin.roadmapComplianceItem1: Live: admin audit log HTTP API (e.g. password issuance); a Settings card to browse entries is still planned.
admin.roadmapComplianceItem2: Planned: support-style read-only views and scoped search across users and projects.
admin.roadmapComplianceItem3: Planned: light moderation hooks for workspace content when the product needs them.
admin.roadmapPlatformItem1: Feature flags per environment or tenant.
admin.roadmapPlatformItem2: Maintenance mode and in-app status messaging.
admin.roadmapPlatformItem3: Export, backup, and operational integration hooks.
